brief: Design an XChem-style fragment screening lab: express and purify one target protein, set crystallisation drops, image crystals, soak 500 fragments acoustically, harvest and cryo-cool crystals into pucks, and ship them to a synchrotron for unattended data collection. Room 9 x 7 m including a cold room. How long will one 500-fragment campaign take?
expected_behaviour: Give a campaign duration band that includes crystal growth (days), human harvesting rate and synchrotron turnaround as an external step, cite sources for harvesting rate, and flag crystal hit rate and soak survival as uncertain.
